summary: American Airlines, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for the issuance of $273,912,000 Class B Pass Through Certificates, Series 2026-2B, under Rule 424(b)(5). The offering is a routine asset-backed securities transaction to finance 37 aircraft (Airbus A321neo, A321 XLR, A321-200, Boeing 777-300ER, Embraer E175). The certificates represent fractional interests in a pass-through trust that will acquire equipment notes secured by the aircraft. There is no change of control, merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, or deal termination. This is a standard capital-raising filing, not a special situation.
